# Rahul Rachhoya

AI engineer based in Gurugram, India, available for remote work. Builds agents,
retrieval systems, fine-tuned models, and model-serving infrastructure.

## Selected public projects
- ai-sdk-research-agent: https://github.com/RahulRachhoya/ai-sdk-research-agent
  Next.js and Vercel AI SDK research agent with hybrid search, MongoDB memory,
  streaming, and telemetry. BM25 token IDs matched Python on 300/300 queries;
  hybrid rankings can differ on ties. Public demo uses Groq; recorded local
  agent benchmarks used Claude on Bedrock.
- finetune-intent-lab: https://github.com/RahulRachhoya/finetune-intent-lab
  QLoRA Qwen2.5-1.5B reached 93.4% on 3,076 Banking77 test queries, versus 36.9%
  zero-shot and 91.1% logistic regression. On the same 300-query subset, QLoRA
  scored 91.0% versus prompted Claude 83.7%. One task and one seed.
- llm-serving-k8s: https://github.com/RahulRachhoya/llm-serving-k8s
  Local one-GPU vLLM deployment on k3d. Peak 185.5 req/s at 32 concurrent requests
  (p50 172 ms); single-request p50 78 ms. Multi-GPU scaling was not tested.
- agent-memory-lab: https://github.com/RahulRachhoya/agent-memory-lab
  SciFact retrieval benchmark over 5,183 abstracts and 300 claims. Qdrant hybrid
  nDCG@10 0.725 versus 0.713 dense, with tie-related variation. LangGraph agent
  adds MongoDB checkpoints, memory, and telemetry. Five demo turns are not an
  evaluation of answer quality.
